description: In the heart of Vienna, a series of art thefts has left the city in turmoil. The stolen pieces are rumored to hold secrets of a bygone era, and whispers of a shadowy figure have emerged. As you delve into the world of art and deception, you must connect the dots between the suspects and their hidden motives. Can you uncover the truth before the final piece disappears forever?

reasoning_chain: Identify the suspect traits from the clues.
Match the traits to the suspects in the database.
Eva Horvath is the only suspect with red hair, a hobby of sketching, and a favorite food of goulash.
Other suspects do not match all traits.
Confirm the geographical plausibility of the final city.

solution: Connect the clues about the red-haired artist seen in Budapest and her obsession with goulash to uncover her motive for stealing the art.
